title: M3 preprocessing result contract / M3 预处理结果合同
description: Machine-readable metadata contract for one corrected M3 preprocessing call. It preserves three non-interchangeable layers: immutable source_raw, bounded-repair repaired_raw, and algorithmic filtered output. / 单次校正后 M3 预处理调用的机器可读元数据合同。它保留三个不可互换层级：不可变 source_raw、有限修复后的 repaired_raw，以及算法滤波后的 filtered 输出。

schema_version.description: Exact result schema identifier; consumers fail closed on any other value. / 精确结果 Schema 标识；消费者遇到其他值时必须拒绝继续。

result_id.description: Run-unique result identifier, not a profile or algorithm identifier. / 单次运行唯一结果标识，不得用配置或算法标识代替。

module_binding_id.description: Binding ID from m3_module_bindings_v1 that selected the callable. / 从 m3_module_bindings_v1 选择实际 callable 的绑定 ID。

module_version.description: Public M3 module API version. / M3 公共模块 API 版本。

profile_id.description: Exact profile_id from m3_preprocessing_profiles_corrected_v1; free-form filter parameters are forbidden at the benchmark boundary. / m3_preprocessing_profiles_corrected_v1 中的精确 profile_id；benchmark 边界禁止自由传入滤波参数。

preprocessing_registry_id.description: Locked preprocessing registry identity. / 冻结预处理注册表标识。

input_summary.description: Metadata for immutable source_raw exactly as supplied before repair; it must never be silently replaced by repaired_raw. / 修复前调用方原样提供且不可变的 source_raw 元数据；不得被 repaired_raw 静默替换。

output_summary.description: Metadata for the algorithmic filtered output. / 算法滤波输出元数据。

source_raw.description: Original observation before interpolation or replacement. / 插值或替换前的原始观测。

repaired_raw.description: Raw-domain signal after only declared bounded repairs and before filtering. / 仅执行已声明有限修复且尚未滤波的原始域信号。

filtered.description: Filtered/resampled signal consumed by downstream physiology or features. / 供下游生理算法或特征使用的滤波/重采样信号。

valid_count.description: Samples accepted after validation and optional bounded repair. / 校验及可选有限修复后被接受的样本数。

invalid_count.description: Samples that remain invalid and must not contribute to features. / 仍无效且不得参与特征计算的样本数。

repaired_count.description: Samples repaired by a declared deterministic policy. / 由已声明确定性策略修复的样本数。

per_channel_valid_count.description: Optional valid counts keyed by canonical channel name. / 以规范通道名为键的可选有效计数。

semantics.description: Normative Boolean mask meaning. / 布尔掩码的规范含义。

reason_codes.description: Only codes registered by m3_reason_codes_corrected_v1 are legal; profile_id and algorithm_id are never reason codes. / 仅允许 m3_reason_codes_corrected_v1 已登记代码；profile_id 与 algorithm_id 永远不得充当原因码。

phase_mode.description: Filtering phase mode selected by the registered profile. / 注册配置选择的滤波相位模式。

timestamp_policy.description: How sample times were obtained. / 样本时间的获得方式。

finite_value_policy.description: NaN and infinity are forbidden; missing numeric values are null with a validity mask and reason code. / 禁止 NaN 与无穷值；缺失数值必须以 null、有效掩码及原因码共同表达。

applied.description: Whether sampling-rate conversion was executed. / 是否实际执行采样率转换。

source_fs_hz.description: Validated source sampling rate in hertz. / 已校验源采样率，单位 Hz。

target_fs_hz.description: Registered target sampling rate in hertz. / 注册目标采样率，单位 Hz。

method.description: Corrected route uses no resampling or explicit SciPy polyphase resampling. / 校正路线仅允许不重采样或显式 SciPy 多相重采样。

shared_index_mapping.description: True when signal, time, masks and annotations use the same source-to-target index mapping; required whenever applied=true. / 信号、时间、掩码与标注使用同一源到目标索引映射时为 true；applied=true 时必须如此。

input_units.description: Units supplied by the caller in channel order. / 调用方按通道顺序提供的单位。

output_units.description: Units emitted after explicit conversion. / 显式转换后输出的单位。

explicit.description: Must be true when any numeric conversion occurred; amplitude-based unit guessing is forbidden. / 发生任何数值换算时必须为 true；禁止按幅值猜测单位。

raw_metrics.description: Layer-qualified metrics only. source_* describes immutable source_raw, repaired_* describes bounded-repair raw, and filtered_* describes algorithm output; source_nonfinite_fraction is always retained. / 仅允许带层级前缀的指标。source_* 描述不可变 source_raw，repaired_* 描述有限修复 raw，filtered_* 描述算法输出；始终保留 source_nonfinite_fraction。

module_metrics.description: Finite scalar diagnostics only; missing numerics use null. / 仅允许有限标量诊断；缺失数值使用 null。

status_mapping_registry_id.description: Registry used to project M3 state into M1 output vocabulary. / 用于把 M3 状态投影到 M1 输出词汇表的注册表。

module_status.description: Normalized module state exposed to the M1 router. / 暴露给 M1 路由器的规范模块状态。

pipeline_status.description: Projected m1.inference_output.v3 pipeline status. / 投影后的 m1.inference_output.v3 流水线状态。

sha256.description: Lower-case SHA-256 digest over canonical bytes. / 规范字节的小写 SHA-256 摘要。

m3_status.description: Native M3 processing status; mapping to M1 is explicit. / M3 原生处理状态；到 M1 的映射必须显式。

tensor_shape.description: Two-dimensional [samples, channels] shape. / 二维 [样本数, 通道数] 形状。

vector_shape.description: One-dimensional [samples] mask shape. / 一维 [样本数] 掩码形状。

source.description: Origin of timestamps. / 时间戳来源。

monotonic.description: Whether timestamps are strictly increasing after validation. / 校验后时间戳是否严格递增。

uniform_grid.description: Whether timestamps lie on the registered uniform grid. / 时间戳是否位于注册均匀网格。

start_s.description: First finite timestamp, or null for empty/invalid input. / 首个有限时间戳；空或无效输入时为 null。

end_s.description: Last finite timestamp, or null for empty/invalid input. / 最后有限时间戳；空或无效输入时为 null。

dtype.description: Declared array dtype; computation may use float64 while model export may use float32. / 已声明数组类型；计算可用 float64，模型导出可用 float32。

channel_order.description: Canonical ordered channel names. / 规范有序通道名称。

units.description: Units aligned one-to-one with channel_order. / 与 channel_order 一一对应的单位。

sampling_rate_hz.description: Validated sampling rate in hertz. / 已校验采样率，单位 Hz。

semantic_role.description: Normative signal-layer meaning. / 规范信号层含义。

mode.description: Payload transport mode; absolute paths are forbidden. / 数据载荷传输方式；禁止绝对路径。

relative_path.description: Relative artifact path, or null for in-memory/not-emitted data. / 相对制品路径；内存或未输出数据时为 null。

key.description: Array key inside the artifact, or null when not applicable. / 制品内数组键；不适用时为 null。

code_root.description: Only M3 src is future-active; root scripts are historical evidence only. / 未来活动实现仅来自 M3 src；根目录脚本仅为历史证据。

source_files.description: Exact M3 implementation files used. / 实际使用的 M3 实现文件。

source_sha256.description: File-relative SHA-256 map. / 相对文件 SHA-256 映射。

dataset_version_id.description: M2 dataset version for benchmark calls, otherwise null. / benchmark 调用的 M2 数据集版本，否则为 null。

fold_registry_id.description: M2 fold registry when fold-fitted state is used, otherwise null. / 使用折内拟合状态时的 M2 折叠注册表，否则为 null。

created_utc.description: UTC creation timestamp in RFC 3339 form. / RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 创建时间。
